title: Use Ask AI to update contacts and deals
blurb: Add contacts, tag people and create opportunities by just asking.

steps.title: Open Ask AI
steps.body: Click **Ask AI** in the left menu.

steps.title: Start a new chat
steps.body: Click **New Chat** so the assistant starts with a clean slate.

steps.title: Say what you need
steps.body: Type the job with the details. For example: "Create an opportunity for Sarah Lee in my Sales pipeline, stage Quote Sent, value $4,500."

steps.title: Check the plan
steps.body: Ask AI shows a summary of the change before it makes it. Check the names, stage and amounts are right.

steps.title: Confirm it
steps.body: Approve the change. For multi-step jobs you'll see a progress list as each step finishes.
steps.tip: Open Contacts or Opportunities afterwards to see the change.
